_comment: Post-publish validation manifest. Defines expected custom fields per entity after a successful Acumatica customization publish. Used by validate-publish.py to verify fields exist in live API responses.

PurchaseOrder._note_containers: UsrExpArrivalDate, UsrActArrivalDate, UsrContainerRef from AesthetikContainers — re-add after first successful publish

SalesOrder._note: UsrHubSpotDealId removed from validation — column exists in SOOrder table but DAC extension not loading in REST API schema. Investigate: AesthetikWMS SOOrderExt may need IsActive() or publish order fix.

StockItem._note_containers: UsrHTSCode, UsrDutyRate, UsrCountryOfOrigin, UsrFiberContent, UsrPreferentialTariff, UsrFreightClass from AesthetikContainers — re-add after first successful publish

_notes.UsrDisablePayLink: CustomerExt : PXCacheExtension<Customer> field. Works on AR303000 screen and in C# (ARInvoiceEntry_PayLink_Extension), but NOT exposed via REST API $adHocSchema for Customer entity. SQL column on BAccount table. Cannot validate via REST API schema check — only via sql_columns.
_notes.UsrHubSpotDealId: SOOrderExt in AesthetikWMS package. DAC field requires ALTER TABLE on SOOrder — created via CustomizationPlugin in AesthetikWMS.
_notes.UsrComplianceHold_REMOVED: Removed from validation — columns need manual creation via SM203510 and are not reliably present. Re-add when confirmed live.
_notes.container_tables: UsrContainer, UsrContainerEvent, UsrContainerPOLink are standalone tables created by AesthetikContainers CustomizationPlugin.UpdateDatabase(). Validated via sql_columns, not entity custom_fields.
_notes.UsrHFExpiryDate: INItemXRefExt : PXCacheExtension<INItemXRef>. Absorbed from WMSynergy ExpirationDateAtStockItems. Tracks vendor-assigned expiry dates on Item Cross-Reference grid (IN202500). Column created via <Sql> element in AesthetikWMS.
